headline: Goa Government Launches 'Mhajo Flat' Scheme for Unregistered Properties
summary: The Goa government has introduced the 'Mhajo Flat' initiative to regularize unregistered housing units across the state. The scheme aims to help property owners secure legal status and official documentation for their flats.

headline: Goa Allows Commercial Establishments to Operate 24x7
summary: The Goa government has permitted shops, malls, and commercial establishments to remain open round-the-clock. This move is designed to boost local business activity and improve consumer convenience.

headline: Goa Govt Targets 100 Flats in Affordable Housing Push
summary: The state government is planning to acquire 100 flats to expand affordable housing options in Goa. The effort aims to provide accessible residential accommodation to local residents.

headline: IFFI 2026 to Screen Over 230 Films With Spain as Country of Honour
summary: The upcoming International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa will feature more than 230 films from around the globe. Spain has been officially named the Country of Honour for the event.

headline: 'Ancessao' Selected to Open Goan Film Section at IFFI
summary: The movie 'Ancessao' has been chosen as the opening film for the Goan Film Section at the International Film Festival of India. The selection highlights regional filmmaking talent at the prestigious festival.

headline: Special Traffic and Parking Plans Announced for IFFI 2026
summary: Authorities in Goa have released dedicated traffic routing and parking guidelines to handle festival crowds during IFFI 2026. The measures aim to prevent congestion and ensure smooth vehicular movement.

headline: Senior Citizens Welcome New Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express
summary: Elderly passengers have praised the newly introduced Vande Bharat train connecting Bengaluru and Goa for its comfort and convenience. The service offers enhanced travel features designed to improve long-distance rail journeys.

headline: Family Completes 2,200 km Mumbai-Goa-Udupi Road Trip
summary: A family detailed their 2,200 km highway journey traveling from Mumbai through Goa to Udupi in a classic sedan. Their trip highlights popular coastal road routes and driving experiences in western India.

headline: Goa Records Increase in Voter Count in SSR Draft Rolls
summary: Draft rolls released under the Special Summary Revision show a rise in registered voters in Goa, Uttarakhand, and Manipur. Punjab's voter count remained unchanged during the same review period.

headline: Proposed Turtle Nesting Sites Spark Livelihood Concerns in Goa
summary: A proposal to designate new coastal zones as turtle nesting sites has triggered anxiety among local coastal communities. Residents express concern that strict conservation rules could adversely affect their daily livelihoods.

headline: Goa Teacher Booked Under POCSO for Stalking Student
summary: A school teacher in Goa faces legal action under the POCSO Act for allegedly stalking a minor student. Police have initiated an investigation into the reported harassment.

headline: Expanded NH-66 Enhances Goa’s Coastal Connectivity and Travel
summary: The widening of National Highway 66 along Goa's coast is improving regional transit and economic growth while preserving scenic views. The project offers smoother travel routes for commuters and visitors alike.

headline: Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 Expected at Motoverse 2026 in Goa
summary: Royal Enfield is expected to launch its high-capacity Himalayan 750 motorcycling model during the Motoverse event in Goa. The annual festival draws biking enthusiasts and industry watchers from across the country.

headline: Man Sentenced to 12 Years for 2018 Rape of Tourist in Palolem
summary: A court has sentenced a Chennai man to 12 years in prison for sexually assaulting a British tourist in Palolem in 2018. The verdict brings closure to a high-profile criminal case in South Goa.

headline: Safety Issues Raised Over Peddem Sports Complex Road
summary: Commuters and locals have raised serious safety concerns regarding traffic management and road conditions near the Peddem Sports Complex. Residents are calling on authorities to implement corrective measures to prevent accidents.

headline: Panaji Mobility Plan Delayed as Capital Faces Traffic Congestion
summary: Implementation of Panaji's comprehensive mobility plan remains stalled while key city roads continue to suffer from heavy traffic jams. Urban planners and citizens are urging swift execution to ease vehicular movement.

headline: Goa Liquor Worth Rs 55 Lakh Confiscated Near Border
summary: Law enforcement agencies seized illicit Goa-made liquor valued at Rs 55 lakh during a border checkpoint operation. The driver of the transport vehicle abandoned the contraband and fled the scene.

headline: Bicholim Police Arrest Teacher for Harassing Minor Student
summary: Goa police have arrested a teacher in Bicholim following allegations of stalking and harassing a female minor student. The accused was taken into custody after an official complaint was lodged.

headline: Goa Forward Party to Target Only Winnable Seats, Says Vijai
summary: GFP chief Vijai Sardesai announced that the party will selectively contest seats where it has strong prospects of winning. The strategy aims to maximize electoral efficiency in upcoming state contests.

headline: Goa Retail Inflation Hits 15-Month High of 4.58% in October
summary: Retail inflation in Goa climbed to 4.58% in October, marking the highest rate recorded in the state over the past 15 months. Price increases in essential commodities contributed to the overall rise.

headline: New Vande Bharat Route Connects Bengaluru to Goa in 13 Hours
summary: The newly introduced Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express offers a 13-hour train connection linking Karnataka and coastal Goa. The service provides passengers with a modern, high-speed rail travel option.

headline: Goa Government Introduces 'Mhajo Flat' Regularization Scheme
summary: The Goa state administration has rolled out the 'Mhajo Flat' initiative targeting unregistered apartment units. Property owners can now apply to regularize their documentation under official state guidelines.

headline: Second Child Abuse Case Reported at North Goa School
summary: Police have filed an FIR against a teacher in North Goa involving allegations of stalking and sexual misconduct against a minor pupil. This marks the second child abuse investigation opened in the area recently.

headline: Goa Grants Approval for 24x7 Operations of Stores and Malls
summary: Retail stores, shopping malls, and commercial outlets in Goa have been authorized to function 24 hours a day. The initiative aims to support nighttime trade and provide greater convenience to shoppers.

headline: 10 Films Selected to Compete for ICFT-Unesco Gandhi Medal at 57th IFFI
summary: Ten international movies have been shortlisted to contend for the prestigious ICFT-Unesco Gandhi Medal at the 57th IFFI in Goa. The award honors films reflecting Mahatma Gandhi's ideals of peace and tolerance.

headline: Goa State to Roll Out AI Training Programs for Job Seekers and Students
summary: The Goa government plans to launch specialized training modules in artificial intelligence for students, job seekers, and working professionals. The skill development initiative aims to boost technical employment opportunities.

headline: Local Entrepreneurs Highlight Value of Social Impact Businesses in Goa
summary: Community entrepreneurs in Goa are emphasizing business models focused on creating positive social and environmental outcomes alongside financial returns. The initiative highlights sustainable growth across local sectors.

headline: Mandrem and Galgibaga Beaches Aim for Blue Flag Certification
summary: Goa’s Mandrem and Galgibaga beaches are under consideration to receive the international Blue Flag eco-label for the 2026-27 season. The certification recognizes high environmental standards, cleanliness, and beach safety.

headline: Stalled District Planning Committees Delay Development Projects
summary: Local governance planning in Goa remains affected as District Planning Committees (DPCs) are yet to be formally constituted. The delay has put several district-level infrastructural initiatives on hold.

headline: Palolem Stakeholders Threaten Agitation Over Proposed Coastal Plan
summary: Local business owners and residents in Palolem have warned of public protests against a proposed beach protection strategy. Stakeholders claim the plan could adversely impact tourism infrastructure and livelihoods.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express Features Rotating Seats and Scenic Views
summary: The new Vande Bharat train on the Bengaluru-Goa route offers passengers 180-degree rotating seats to view scenic Western Ghat landscapes. The upgraded coaches provide enhanced comfort for rail travelers.

headline: Forest Department Identifies 24 Goa Beaches for Turtle Nesting
summary: Goa's Forest Department has submitted a proposal designating 24 coastal stretches as protected turtle nesting habitats. The initiative aims to strengthen marine conservation efforts across the state.

headline: Canacona Residents Oppose Plan to Cover Entire Coast as Turtle Nesting Area
summary: Locals in Canacona have expressed anger over a proposal that would classify the entire stretch of Canacona coastline under turtle nesting regulations. Residents fear severe restrictions on traditional coastal activities.

headline: Daman Replaces Kalyan Chaubey as Representative for AIFF Elections
summary: The Daman football body has decided not to field AIFF President Kalyan Chaubey as its official delegate for the upcoming AIFF elections. The decision alters representation dynamics ahead of the national sports body vote.

headline: Six Passengers Unhurt as Bus Veers Off Road in Canacona
summary: Six individuals escaped without injuries after a KSRTC bus ran off the roadway in Canacona. Emergency services responded promptly to secure the vehicle and assist travelers.

headline: Goa Prepares for Cinema Showcase as 57th IFFI Nears
summary: Preparations are underway in Goa to host global filmmakers and cinema enthusiasts for the 57th International Film Festival of India. Venues across Panaji are being readied for screenings and cultural events.

headline: Goa Residents Express Concern Over Impact of Rising Inflation
summary: Higher living costs and rising retail inflation are placing financial pressure on household budgets across Goa. Citizens are urging measures to stabilize prices on food and everyday essential items.

headline: KTC Issues Notice to Mapusa Bus Stand Parking Operator for Overcharging
summary: The Kadamba Transport Corporation has served a formal notice to the parking contractor at Mapusa bus stand following complaints of fee overcharging. Authorities have warned of strict action if compliance is not maintained.

headline: Veteran Journalists Honored at State-Level Function in Goa
summary: Senior media professionals were felicitated for their contributions to journalism during a state-level ceremony in Goa. Officials commended the awardees for their dedication to public interest reporting.

headline: Police Uncover Multiple Motives in Porvorim Casino Shootout Investigation
summary: Investigators probing the recent shootout incident near a Porvorim casino have identified several potential motives behind the attack. Further questioning of suspects is ongoing to establish accountability.

headline: Tourist Overcharged for Parking at Mapusa KTC Bus Stand
summary: A visitor to Goa reported being charged double the prescribed rate for parking at the Mapusa KTC bus terminal. The incident has drawn fresh calls for strict oversight of private parking operators.

headline: Two Passengers Detained for Consuming Alcohol on Goa-Bound Flight
summary: Airline crew flagged two travelers for unauthorized alcohol consumption aboard a flight bound for Goa. The individuals were handed over to security personnel upon landing for legal proceedings.

headline: Food Safety Department Inspects Unlicensed Poultry Outlets in Goa
summary: Food safety officials conducted enforcement drives targeting an unlicensed chicken supplier operating without valid health permits. Authorities confiscated non-compliant goods to safeguard public health standards.

headline: Canacona Farmers Seek Assistance Over Crop Damage Caused by Wild Animals
summary: Agricultural workers in Canacona are demanding government intervention after wildlife attacks damaged extensive farmland crops. Farmers are requesting compensation and protective measures to secure their fields.

headline: Demand Grows to Rehabilitate Families Evacuated From Unsafe Borda Building
summary: Calls are mounting for the prompt rehabilitation of families evacuated from an unsafe residential structure in Borda. Affected occupants are seeking temporary housing and permanent relocation solutions.

headline: Congress and GFP Initiate Pre-Poll Alliance Talks for 2027 Goa Elections
summary: The Congress party and Goa Forward Party have opened preliminary discussions regarding a potential seat-sharing alliance for the 2027 state assembly polls. Leaders aim to form a united political front.

headline: Seraulim Violence Ignites Concerns Over Escalating Gang Activity
summary: A physical assault in Seraulim has raised fresh public apprehension regarding rivalry between local criminal groups in South Goa. Police have stepped up vigilance and patrols in the region.

headline: Prudent Media Wins Multiple Honors at Goa State Journalism Awards
summary: News outlet Prudent Media secured several top accolades at the annual Goa State Journalism Awards ceremony. The organization was recognized across multiple categories for excellence in news reporting.

headline: Vasco's Swatantra Path Revamp Targeted for Completion by Late December
summary: Upgradation work on Vasco's prominent Swatantra Path thoroughfare is scheduled to wrap up by the end of December. The makeover aims to improve pedestrian pathways, road surfaces, and urban infrastructure.

headline: Experts Emphasize Need to Overhaul Water Resource Management in India
summary: Environmental policy experts have stressed the importance of long-term sustainable strategies to address growing water supply challenges in Goa and across India. The focus remains on conservation and infrastructure reform.
